Title: React tutorial — Lily Design System

Description: Build accessible, styled form with Lily React headless components: typed function components wey get value + onChange.

# React tutorial

Typed function components, one file each, controlled with di standard `value` + `onChange` pattern — everything dey work di way React dey already work.

## Wetin you go build

Small contact form — input wey get label, submit button, controlled state, real keyboard and screen-reader behaviour — first bare, then styled, for about 10 minutes.

## Before you start

You need git, Node 22 or newer, and pnpm 10 or newer. Any React 18+ project dey work — Next.js, Vite, or plain React.

## Step 1 — Get di code

```
git clone https://github.com/LilyDesignSystem/lily-design-system
cd lily-design-system/lily-design-system-react-headless
pnpm install
pnpm test        # vitest + @testing-library/react
pnpm run storybook   # browse all 608 components
```

Di components na flat files for `components/` — `Button.tsx`, `TextInput.tsx` — each one with im test, story, and docs beside am. Copy di files wey you need enter your app, or vendor di repo and import from am.

## Step 2 — Your first component

```
import Button from "lily-design-system-react-headless/components/Button";

export function SaveBar() {
  return <Button onClick={save}>Save</Button>;
}
```

E dey render `<button class="button" type="button">`. Props: `type`, `disabled`, `pressed` (e dey render `aria-pressed`), `label` (an `aria-label` override), `className`, and any extra attribute go spread onto di root element.

## Step 3 — Compose small form

```
import { useState } from "react";
import Form from ".../components/Form";
import Field from ".../components/Field";
import TextInput from ".../components/TextInput";
import Button from ".../components/Button";

export function ContactForm() {
  const [name, setName] = useState("");
  return (
    <Form label="Contact form" onSubmit={handleSubmit}>
      <Field label="Full name" required>
        <TextInput id="name" label="Full name" value={name} onChange={setName} required />
      </Field>
      <Button type="submit">Save</Button>
    </Form>
  );
}
```

`Field` dey take di visible `label` as im own prop instead of nested label component — pass am once, on `Field`, and `TextInput`for `label` dey provide di accessible name.

**Verified 2026-08-29:** earlier draft nest separate `Label` inside `Field`, wey render *two* labels (one empty) because `Field` already dey render im own from di `label` prop — dem catch am by compiling di exact snippet. Di [contact-form composed route](https://github.com/LilyDesignSystem/lily-design-system/blob/main/lily-design-system-react-next-examples/app/contact-form/page.tsx) na di same pattern, wey real e2e and axe tests don exercise.

## Step 4 — Style am

Everything above dey render as pure structure, ready for your styles. Style di hooks — `.button`, `.text-input`, `.label`, `.field` — inside your stylesheet, layer Tailwind utilities through `className`, or link ready-made theme:

```
<link rel="stylesheet" href="/themes/united-states-web-design-system.css" />
```

## Step 5 — See everything dey work

Di [Next.js example app](https://lilydesignsystem.com/pcm-001/examples/) na di full catalog styled and demoed, with Playwright e2e and axe-core baseline:

```
git clone https://github.com/LilyDesignSystem/lily-design-system
cd lily-design-system/lily-design-system-react-next-examples
pnpm install && pnpm run dev
```
